title: Fields and Modules

syllabus.details: Definition of field, extensions of fields, algebraic extensions, existence of algebraic closure,normal extensions, separable extensions
Galois extensions and Galois theory of finite Galois extensions
Modules, Noetherian rings, Hilbert basis theorem
